title: Building arrangements around the leader
summary: Arrangements were built around Cootie's trumpet, and he and Dance discuss a leader's duty to deliver.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players
